say.en: Walk 3 metres east and then 4 metres north. You walked 7 metres, but you are only 5 metres from where you started. Vectors add by joining arrows head to tail, not by adding lengths. In this lesson: Add vectors by the triangle and parallelogram laws.
Multiply a vector by a scalar.

body.en: Place the tail of $\vec b$ at the head of $\vec a$; the vector from the tail of $\vec a$ to the head of $\vec b$ is $\vec a + \vec b$. Equivalently, it is the diagonal of the *parallelogram* with $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ as adjacent sides. Addition is commutative and associative, and $\vec{AB} + \vec{BC} + \vec{CA} = \vec 0$.
body.kn: b ಯ ಬಾಲವನ್ನು a ಯ ತಲೆಗೆ ಇಡಿ; a ಯ ಬಾಲದಿಂದ b ಯ ತಲೆಯವರೆಗಿನ ಸದಿಶವೇ a + b. ಇದು ಸಮಾಂತರ ಚತುರ್ಭುಜದ ಕರ್ಣ. AB + BC + CA = 0.

narration.en: Put the tail of b at the head of a. The arrow from the start of a to the end of b is a plus b. It is also the diagonal of the parallelogram on a and b. And going round a triangle, A B plus B C plus C A is the zero vector.

say.en: Put the tail of b at the head of a. The arrow from the start of a to the end of b is a plus b. It is also the diagonal of the parallelogram on a and b. And going round a triangle, A B plus B C plus C A is the zero vector. a⃗ plus b⃗ = b⃗ plus a⃗ commutative.
say.kn: b ಯ ಬಾಲವನ್ನು a ಯ ತಲೆಗೆ ಇಡಿ; a ಯ ಬಾಲದಿಂದ b ಯ ತಲೆಯವರೆಗಿನ ಸದಿಶವೇ a plus b. ಇದು ಸಮಾಂತರ ಚತುರ್ಭುಜದ ಕರ್ಣ. AB plus BC plus CA equals 0.

narration.en: The teacher draws the triangle and parallelogram laws, scalar multiples, and adds two vectors by components.

say.en: Triangle law: go from A to B, then from B to C. The single trip from A to C is the sum.
Parallelogram law: complete the parallelogram. The diagonal from the common tail is the sum, so a plus b equals b plus a.
Multiplying by a scalar stretches the vector. Two a is twice as long. Minus a points the other way.
Example: a = i plus 2 j minus 3 k, b = 2 i minus j plus 3 k. Add the components: a plus b = 3 i plus j.
Its length is root 10. Divide by the length to get the unit vector.

title.en: Multiplying by a scalar; unit vectors

body.en: For a *scalar* $\lambda$, $\lambda\vec a$ has magnitude $|\lambda|\,|\vec a|$; it points the same way as $\vec a$ if $\lambda > 0$ and the opposite way if $\lambda < 0$. Dividing a non-zero vector by its magnitude gives the unit vector $\hat a = \frac{\vec a}{|\vec a|}$.
body.kn: λa ಯ ಪರಿಮಾಣ |λ||a|; λ > 0 ಆದರೆ ಅದೇ ದಿಕ್ಕು, λ < 0 ಆದರೆ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕು. ಸದಿಶವನ್ನು ಅದರ ಪರಿಮಾಣದಿಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಿದರೆ ಏಕಮಾನ ಸದಿಶ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Component-wise: λ(a₁î + a₂ĵ + a₃k̂) = λa₁î + λa₂ĵ + λa₃k̂

narration.en: Multiplying by a number lambda stretches the vector by the size of lambda. A negative lambda also reverses it. Divide any non-zero vector by its own length and you get the unit vector in its direction.
narration.kn: λa ಯ ಪರಿಮಾಣ |λ||a|; λ > 0 ಆದರೆ ಅದೇ ದಿಕ್ಕು, λ < 0 ಆದರೆ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕು. ಸದಿಶವನ್ನು ಅದರ ಪರಿಮಾಣದಿಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಿದರೆ ಏಕಮಾನ ಸದಿಶ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.

Divide any non-zero vector by its own length and you get the unit vector in its direction. Component-wise: lambda (a 1î plus a 2ĵ plus a 3k̂) equals lambda a 1î plus lambda a 2ĵ plus lambda a 3k̂.
say.kn: lambda a ಯ ಪರಿಮಾಣ | lambda ||a|; lambda > 0 ಆದರೆ ಅದೇ ದಿಕ್ಕು, lambda < 0 ಆದರೆ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕು. ಸದಿಶವನ್ನು ಅದರ ಪರಿಮಾಣದಿಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಿದರೆ ಏಕಮಾನ ಸದಿಶ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: If a⃗ = î + 2ĵ − 3k̂ and b⃗ = 2î − ĵ + 3k̂, find the unit vector in the direction of a⃗ + b⃗.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. If a⃗ = î + 2ĵ − 3k̂ and b⃗ = 2î − ĵ + 3k̂, find the unit vector in the direction of a⃗ + b⃗.

say.en: Let us solve this together. If a⃗ = î plus 2ĵ minus 3k̂ and b⃗ = 2î - ĵ plus 3k̂, find the unit vector in the direction of a⃗ plus b⃗.
a⃗ plus b⃗ = 1 plus 2î plus 2 minus 1ĵ plus minus 3 plus 3k̂ = 3î plus ĵ.
|a⃗ plus b⃗| = the square root of 9 plus 1 equals the square root of 10.
Unit vector equals 3î plus ĵ/ the square root of 10.
So the answer is 3î plus ĵ/ the square root of 10.
